title: MatchWise | Unified Monitoring
description: Unified operations view grouped by service: Frontend (Vercel), Backend (Render), Database (Supabase), Oracle VM and log collection. Every service opens with the same KPI strips (status, success rate, check duration, freshness, CPU, memory; traffic, errors, latency). Vercel host CPU/RAM is shown as n/a because it is not collected.

panels.title: MatchWise · Operations overview
panels.description: High-level view of all currently collected monitoring data.

options.content:
**Grouped by service.** Every service opens with the same two KPI strips: *status · success rate · check duration · freshness · CPU · memory*, then *traffic · errors · latency*. Colours: blue frontend · orange backend · green database · purple Oracle.

Missing data ≠ zero. For side-by-side comparison open the **Service Comparison** dashboard (link above).

panels.title: Frontend · Status
panels.description: Latest HTTP probe within three minutes while the exporter works. Not a continuous availability SLA.

panels.title: Backend · Status
panels.description: Latest HTTP probe within three minutes while the exporter works. Not a continuous availability SLA.

panels.title: Database · Status
panels.description: PostgreSQL reachability (pg_up), shown only while the Supabase scrape succeeds.

panels.title: Oracle · Status
panels.description: Node Exporter scrape success on the Oracle machine.

panels.title: Backend · Error rate (%)
panels.description: 4xx+5xx share of logged requests, 5-minute window. Traffic and Route contains filters apply.

targets.expr: 100 * ((sum(rate({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" | statusCode >= 400 | __error__="" [5m])) or (sum(rate({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" [5m])) * 0)) / (sum(rate({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" [5m])) > 0))

panels.title: Frontend · Error rate (%)
panels.description: 4xx+5xx share of browser-observed HTTP responses, 5-minute window.

targets.expr: (100 * ((sum(rate(frontend_api_http_responses_total{job="frontend_traffic",mode="real",status=~"4..|5.."}[5m])) or on() (0 * sum(rate(frontend_api_http_responses_total{job="frontend_traffic",mode="real"}[5m])))) / sum(rate(frontend_api_http_responses_total{job="frontend_traffic",mode="real"}[5m])))) and on() (sum(rate(frontend_api_http_responses_total{job="frontend_traffic",mode="real"}[5m])) > 0) and on() ((min(up{job="frontend_traffic"}) == 1) and on() (time() - max(frontend_telemetry_mode_last_received_timestamp_seconds{job="frontend_traffic",mode="real"}) < 180))

panels.title: Log collector · age since successful run
panels.description: Seconds since the last successful log collector run. Not the age of the last business request.

panels.title: Backend · HTTP 5xx · Selected period
panels.description: HTTP 5xx responses found in Pino application logs within the selected dashboard time range. Traffic and Route contains controls apply. An empty result means no matching logs. Check collector health and newest event before interpreting zero errors.

targets.expr: (sum(count_over_time({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" | statusCode >= 500 | __error__="" [$__range])) or (sum(count_over_time({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" [$__range])) * 0))

targets.expr: (100 * ((sum(rate(frontend_api_http_responses_total{job="frontend_traffic",mode="real",status=~"4..|5.."}[5m])) or on() (0 * sum(rate(frontend_api_http_responses_total{job="frontend_traffic",mode="real"}[5m])))) / sum(rate(frontend_api_http_responses_total{job="frontend_traffic",mode="real"}[5m])))) and on() (sum(rate(frontend_api_http_responses_total{job="frontend_traffic",mode="real"}[5m])) > 0) and on() ((min(up{job="frontend_traffic"}) == 1) and on() (time() - max(frontend_telemetry_mode_last_received_timestamp_seconds{job="frontend_traffic",mode="real"}) < 180))

targets.expr: ((1000 * histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(frontend_api_fetch_headers_seconds_bucket{job="frontend_traffic",mode="real",outcome="http"}[5m])))) and on() (sum(rate(frontend_api_fetch_headers_seconds_count{job="frontend_traffic",mode="real",outcome="http"}[5m])) > 0)) and on() ((min(up{job="frontend_traffic"}) == 1) and on() (time() - max(frontend_telemetry_last_received_timestamp_seconds{job="frontend_traffic"}) < 180))

targets.expr: ((sum(rate(frontend_api_http_responses_total{job="frontend_traffic",mode="real",status=~"4.."}[5m])) or on() (0 * sum(rate(frontend_api_http_responses_total{job="frontend_traffic",mode="real"}[5m])))) * 60) and on() ((min(up{job="frontend_traffic"}) == 1) and on() (time() - max(frontend_telemetry_last_received_timestamp_seconds{job="frontend_traffic"}) < 180))

((sum(rate(frontend_api_http_responses_total{job="frontend_traffic",mode="real",status=~"5.."}[5m])) or on() (0 * sum(rate(frontend_api_http_responses_total{job="frontend_traffic",mode="real"}[5m])))) * 60) and on() ((min(up{job="frontend_traffic"}) == 1) and on() (time() - max(frontend_telemetry_last_received_timestamp_seconds{job="frontend_traffic"}) < 180))

panels.title: Frontend · Latest HTTP status code

panels.title: Frontend · Latest HTTP probe time
panels.description: Timestamp of the latest stored frontend probe sample.

panels.title: Frontend · Probe samples · Selected period
panels.description: Counts actual stored frontend probe samples in the selected range, per URL.

panels.title: Frontend · Exporter scrape
panels.description: A value of 1 means Prometheus could scrape the probe exporter.

panels.title: Frontend · HTTP probe duration
panels.description: Frontend HTTP probe duration as observed from the Oracle VM.

panels.title: Frontend · HTTP probe results
panels.description: Success of each sampled frontend HTTP check.

panels.title: Backend · Status
panels.description: Latest HTTP probe within three minutes while the exporter works. Not a continuous availability SLA.

panels.title: Backend · Check success rate
panels.description: Share of successful checks (HTTP probe or scrape) in the selected period. Not a contractual SLA.

panels.title: Backend · Check duration

panels.title: Backend · Data freshness
panels.description: Age of the latest actual sample (one-minute sampling). A missing sample is no data, not zero.

panels.title: Backend · CPU (%)
panels.description: CPU utilisation (Render Metrics API, separate collector).

targets.expr: (matchwise_render_cpu_utilization_percent{job="node_exporter",service="matchwise_backend"}) and ((matchwise_render_metrics_collection_success{job="node_exporter",service="matchwise_backend"} == 1) and (time() - matchwise_render_metrics_last_attempt_timestamp_seconds{job="node_exporter",service="matchwise_backend"} < 240) and (time() - matchwise_render_metrics_source_timestamp_seconds{job="node_exporter",service="matchwise_backend"} < 300) and on(job,instance) (up{job="node_exporter"} == 1) and on(job,instance) (node_textfile_scrape_error{job="node_exporter"} == 0))

panels.title: Backend · Memory (%)
panels.description: Memory utilisation (Render Metrics API, separate collector).

targets.expr: (matchwise_render_memory_utilization_percent{job="node_exporter",service="matchwise_backend"}) and ((matchwise_render_metrics_collection_success{job="node_exporter",service="matchwise_backend"} == 1) and (time() - matchwise_render_metrics_last_attempt_timestamp_seconds{job="node_exporter",service="matchwise_backend"} < 240) and (time() - matchwise_render_metrics_source_timestamp_seconds{job="node_exporter",service="matchwise_backend"} < 300) and on(job,instance) (up{job="node_exporter"} == 1) and on(job,instance) (node_textfile_scrape_error{job="node_exporter"} == 0))

panels.title: Backend · Requests / min
panels.description: Logged HTTP requests per minute, 5-minute window. Traffic and Route contains filters apply.

targets.expr: sum(rate({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" [5m])) * 60

panels.title: Backend · 4xx / min
panels.description: 4xx responses per minute. Traffic and Route contains filters apply.

targets.expr: (sum(rate({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" | statusCode >= 400 | statusCode < 500 | __error__="" [5m])) or (sum(rate({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" [5m])) * 0)) * 60

panels.title: Backend · 5xx / min
panels.description: 5xx responses per minute. Traffic and Route contains filters apply.

targets.expr: (sum(rate({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" | statusCode >= 500 | __error__="" [5m])) or (sum(rate({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" [5m])) * 0)) * 60

panels.title: Backend · Error rate (%)
panels.description: 4xx+5xx share of logged requests, 5-minute window. Traffic and Route contains filters apply.

targets.expr: 100 * ((sum(rate({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" | statusCode >= 400 | __error__="" [5m])) or (sum(rate({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" [5m])) * 0)) / (sum(rate({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" [5m])) > 0))

panels.title: Backend · Latency P95
panels.description: Processing time P95 from logs, 5-minute window. Traffic and Route contains filters apply.

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.95, {job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" | unwrap duration_ms | __error__="" [5m]) by (job)

panels.title: Backend · Latest HTTP event
panels.description: Time of the latest HTTP event visible in Loki (last hour). It does not advance without traffic.

targets.expr: 1000 * max(max_over_time({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | label_format event_epoch="{{ __timestamp__ | unixEpoch }}" | unwrap event_epoch | __error__="" [1h]) by (job))

panels.title: Backend · Requests/min · 5-minute average
panels.description: Logged backend HTTP requests as a five-minute average expressed per minute. Traffic and route filters apply. The comparison dashboard instead filters specifically for API route groups.

targets.expr: sum(rate({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" [5m])) * 60

panels.title: Backend · HTTP errors/min
panels.description: 4xx and 5xx HTTP errors per minute (five-minute rolling window). Zero is shown when there are no matching errors.

targets.expr: (sum(rate({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" | statusCode >= 400 | statusCode < 500 | __error__="" [5m])) or (sum(rate({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" [5m])) * 0)) * 60

(sum(rate({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" | statusCode >= 500 | __error__="" [5m])) or (sum(rate({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" [5m])) * 0)) * 60

panels.title: Backend · Processing time P50 / P95 · 15 minutes
panels.description: Logged application processing time P50 and P95 over a rolling 15-minute window. These are neither HTTP probe durations nor full browser response times.

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.50, {job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" | unwrap duration_ms | __error__="" [15m]) by (job)

quantile_over_time(0.95, {job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" | unwrap duration_ms | __error__="" [15m]) by (job)

panels.title: Backend · HTTP status codes · Rolling 5 minutes
panels.description: HTTP response code counts per five-minute rolling window.

targets.expr: sum by (statusCode) (count_over_time({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" | statusCode=~"[1-5][0-9][0-9]" [5m]))

panels.title: Backend · CPU and memory (%)
panels.description: Utilisation relative to the service's own capacity.

targets.expr: (matchwise_render_cpu_utilization_percent{job="node_exporter",service="matchwise_backend"}) and ((matchwise_render_metrics_collection_success{job="node_exporter",service="matchwise_backend"} == 1) and (time() - matchwise_render_metrics_last_attempt_timestamp_seconds{job="node_exporter",service="matchwise_backend"} < 240) and (time() - matchwise_render_metrics_source_timestamp_seconds{job="node_exporter",service="matchwise_backend"} < 300) and on(job,instance) (up{job="node_exporter"} == 1) and on(job,instance) (node_textfile_scrape_error{job="node_exporter"} == 0))

(matchwise_render_memory_utilization_percent{job="node_exporter",service="matchwise_backend"}) and ((matchwise_render_metrics_collection_success{job="node_exporter",service="matchwise_backend"} == 1) and (time() - matchwise_render_metrics_last_attempt_timestamp_seconds{job="node_exporter",service="matchwise_backend"} < 240) and (time() - matchwise_render_metrics_source_timestamp_seconds{job="node_exporter",service="matchwise_backend"} < 300) and on(job,instance) (up{job="node_exporter"} == 1) and on(job,instance) (node_textfile_scrape_error{job="node_exporter"} == 0))

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" [$__range]))

panels.description: Client error responses (HTTP 4xx) during the selected period. Traffic and Route contains controls apply. An empty result means no matching logs. Check collector health and newest event before interpreting zero errors.

panels.title: HTTP 5xx · Selected period
panels.description: Server error responses (HTTP 5xx) during the selected period. Traffic and Route contains controls apply. An empty result means no matching logs. Check collector health and newest event before interpreting zero errors.

targets.expr: (sum(count_over_time({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" | statusCode >= 500 | __error__="" [$__range])) or (sum(count_over_time({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" [$__range])) * 0))

panels.title: HTTP error rate · 4xx and 5xx
panels.description: Share of Pino HTTP requests with a 4xx or 5xx response. Traffic and Route contains controls apply. An empty result means no matching logs. Check collector health and newest event before interpreting zero errors.

targets.expr: 100 * (sum(count_over_time({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" | statusCode >= 400 | __error__="" [$__range])) or (sum(count_over_time({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" [$__range])) * 0)) / (sum(count_over_time({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" [$__range])) > 0)

panels.description: Matching HTTP 401 responses in the selected period. May be an expected authentication rejection. Click to inspect.

targets.expr: (sum(count_over_time({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" | statusCode = 401 | __error__="" [$__range])) or (sum(count_over_time({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" [$__range])) * 0))

panels.title: Backend · Most frequently logged routes
panels.description: Top ten routes by HTTP request count in the selected time range, shown as one horizontal bar per route. Traffic and Route contains controls apply. The count field uses exact whole numbers. Click a bar through its tooltip to inspect the route logs.

targets.expr: sort_desc(topk(10, sum by (route) (count_over_time({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" | route != "" [$__range]))))

panels.title: Backend · Endpoint summary
panels.description: One row per HTTP method and logged route. Five instant Loki tables are joined on the combined method/route key. Shows exact request and error counts, selected-period P95 in milliseconds and numeric timing sample count. Missing timings remain empty. Traffic and Route contains apply. Click a Route to inspect logs.

targets.expr: sum by (method, route, endpoint) (count_over_time({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | label_format endpoint="{{.method}} {{.route}}" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" [$__range]))

(sum by (endpoint) (count_over_time({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | label_format endpoint="{{.method}} {{.route}}" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" | statusCode >= 400 | statusCode < 500 | __error__="" [$__range])) or (sum by (endpoint) (count_over_time({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | label_format endpoint="{{.method}} {{.route}}" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" [$__range])) * 0))

(sum by (endpoint) (count_over_time({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | label_format endpoint="{{.method}} {{.route}}" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" | statusCode >= 500 | __error__="" [$__range])) or (sum by (endpoint) (count_over_time({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | label_format endpoint="{{.method}} {{.route}}" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" [$__range])) * 0))

quantile_over_time(0.95, {job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | label_format endpoint="{{.method}} {{.route}}" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" | unwrap duration_ms | __error__="" [$__range]) by (endpoint)

sum by (endpoint) (count_over_time({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | label_format endpoint="{{.method}} {{.route}}" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | route!~"${excluded_route:raw}" | route=~".*${route_filter:regex}.*" | duration_ms >= 0 | __error__="" [$__range]))

panels.title: Successful logins · 200
panels.description: Login completed successfully and returned a token. Counts POST /api/auth/login (logged as /auth/login or /api/auth/login) during the selected dashboard time range. These six auth counters use the whole HTTP log stream and are independent of Traffic, Route contains, Log status and Request ID controls. Zero means HTTP events were observed in the interval but no matching outcome was found. No matching logs means the HTTP baseline is absent. Query failures remain visible as panel errors.

targets.expr: (sum(count_over_time({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", method="method", route="route", statusCode="statusCode" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | method="POST" | route=~"(/api)?/auth/login" | statusCode = 200 | __error__="" [$__range])) or (sum(count_over_time({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", method="method", route="route", statusCode="statusCode" | event="http_request" | __error__="" [$__range])) * 0))

panels.title: Backend · Latest HTTP status code
panels.description: Latest HTTP probe observation within three minutes, shown only while its exporter is reachable. Probe duration includes DNS, connection and network time; it is not backend application processing time.

panels.title: Backend · Latest HTTP probe time
panels.description: Timestamp of the latest stored backend probe sample.

panels.title: Backend · Probe samples · Selected period
panels.description: Counts actual stored probe samples in the selected range, per URL. Display points in a range graph may repeat these samples.

panels.title: Backend · Exporter scrape
panels.description: A value of 1 means Prometheus could scrape the probe exporter. HTTP probe success is shown separately.

panels.title: Backend · HTTP probe results
panels.description: Range evaluation can repeat the latest stored sample at multiple display points. Sampling interval is one minute. Use Actual probe samples for the number of independent measurements.

panels.title: Database · Status
panels.description: PostgreSQL reachability (pg_up), shown only while the Supabase scrape succeeds.

panels.title: Database · Check success rate
panels.description: Share of successful checks (HTTP probe or scrape) in the selected period. Not a contractual SLA.

panels.title: Database · Check duration
panels.description: Latest Prometheus scrape duration for the Supabase metrics endpoint. Not SQL query time.

panels.title: Database · Data freshness
panels.description: Age of the latest actual sample (one-minute sampling). A missing sample is no data, not zero.

panels.title: Database · CPU (%)
panels.description: CPU utilisation

panels.title: Database · Memory (%)
panels.description: Memory utilisation

panels.title: Database · Transactions / min
panels.description: Committed PostgreSQL transactions per minute; includes internal services. Not an HTTP request count.

panels.title: Database · Rollbacks / min
panels.description: Rolled-back transactions per minute.

panels.title: Database · Deadlock / min
panels.description: PostgreSQL deadlocks per minute.

panels.title: Database · Error rate (%)
panels.description: Rolled-back share of transactions. Not an HTTP error rate; a rollback alone is not necessarily a fault.

panels.title: Database · Connection slots (%)
panels.description: Connection slots used versus the maximum.

panels.title: Database · PostgREST waiting
panels.description: Requests waiting for a PostgREST pool connection. Not all PostgreSQL waiting.

panels.title: Database · Committed and rolled-back transactions
panels.description: Committed and rolled-back PostgreSQL transactions per second, averaged over five minutes. Includes internal services and other clients; this is not an HTTP request count.

panels.title: Database · Connections by role
panels.description: Connection counts by PostgreSQL role, such as authenticator and supabase_auth_admin. Useful for identifying which service consumes connection slots. Roles are database identities.

panels.title: Database · CPU and memory (%)
panels.description: Database host CPU and memory utilization for the selected Supabase target.

panels.title: Database · Filesystem utilization
panels.description: Root and data filesystem usage shown separately. The root filesystem contains operating-system files. The data filesystem holds database storage. Values describe allocated filesystem capacity.

panels.title: Database · Data filesystem used (%)
panels.description: Allocated /data filesystem utilization, using space available to unprivileged users. Display thresholds are 80% and 90%. This measures filesystem capacity. Plan storage allowances must be checked separately in Supabase. A missing /data mount remains No data.

panels.title: Database · Open connections
panels.description: Exported PostgreSQL connection count summed across database roles. Includes internal Supabase services and pooled server connections. This counts database connections, independently of application logins.

panels.title: Database · Database size
panels.description: Database size in bytes, summed across exported databases except template0 and template1. Includes database objects such as tables and indexes. WAL and filesystem usage are separate measures.

panels.title: Database · Metrics scrape
panels.description: Prometheus scrape status for the selected Supabase target. UP confirms the Metrics API scrape. PostgreSQL reachability is shown separately.

panels.title: Database · PostgreSQL buffer cache hit ratio
panels.description: Block hits / (block hits + block reads), calculated from five-minute rates. A zero denominator produces no ratio. PostgreSQL buffer cache hits exclude operating-system cache effects. Interpret changes alongside traffic and I/O, especially on a new database.

panels.title: Database · Temporary-file writes
panels.description: Bytes per second written by queries to temporary files, for example when sorts or hashes spill to disk. Sustained growth alongside slow requests can indicate query or memory pressure.

panels.title: PostgREST · Waiting requests
panels.description: Requests waiting for a connection in the PostgREST pool only. This is not all PostgreSQL waiting, locking or backend traffic.

panels.title: Database · Deadlocks and pool timeouts/min
panels.description: Five-minute event rates expressed per minute. PostgreSQL deadlocks and PostgREST pool timeouts are separate series. Rollbacks or correlated activity alone do not prove an attack.

panels.title: Database · Disk throughput
panels.description: Disk throughput shown per device to avoid summing logical and physical layers together. Loop, RAM and removable-style devices are excluded.

panels.title: Database · Average disk operation time
panels.description: Average read/write time per completed I/O over five minutes, per device. When no operations complete, the corresponding average has no value. Interpret alongside throughput and application latency.

panels.title: Oracle · Status
panels.description: Node Exporter scrape success on the Oracle machine.

panels.title: Oracle · Check success rate
panels.description: Share of successful checks (HTTP probe or scrape) in the selected period. Not a contractual SLA.

panels.title: Oracle · Check duration
panels.description: Latest Prometheus scrape duration of Node Exporter. Not an application response time.

panels.title: Oracle · Data freshness
panels.description: Age of the latest actual sample (one-minute sampling). A missing sample is no data, not zero.

panels.title: Oracle · CPU (%)
panels.description: CPU utilisation

panels.title: Oracle · Memory (%)
panels.description: Memory utilisation

panels.title: Oracle · Uptime
panels.description: Seconds since the Oracle VM last booted.

panels.title: Oracle · System load · 1 minute
panels.description: One-minute system load average.

panels.title: Oracle · Root filesystem (%)
panels.description: Root filesystem utilization on the Oracle VM.

panels.title: Oracle · Available memory
panels.description: Available system memory, excluding reclaimable/cached memory that is in use.

panels.title: Oracle · Available disk space
panels.description: Available storage on the Oracle VM root filesystem.

panels.title: Oracle · Textfile collector error
panels.description: Node Exporter textfile scrape error flag: 0 = OK, 1 = error.

panels.title: Oracle · CPU and memory (%)
panels.description: Utilisation relative to the service's own capacity.

panels.title: Oracle · Root filesystem (%)
panels.description: Root filesystem used space percentage.

panels.title: Oracle · Disk throughput
panels.description: Read and write throughput of block devices. Diskstats are recorded by Node Exporter.

panels.title: Oracle · Network throughput
panels.description: Receive/transmit throughput from non-loopback network interfaces (Docker and veth devices excluded).

panels.title: Oracle · System load · 1 / 5 / 15 minutes
panels.description: Linux 1-, 5- and 15-minute system load averages; a load average is not CPU usage percent.

panels.title: Log collector · Age since successful run
panels.description: Seconds since the last successful log collector run. This is not the age of the last business request.

panels.title: Log collector · HTTP events · Selected period
panels.description: Unfiltered HTTP events in Loki for the selected range. Compare with filtered request totals to distinguish filter effects from lack of data.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event", route="route", method="method", statusCode="statusCode", duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | event="http_request" | __error__="" [$__range]))

panels.title: Loki · Latest HTTP event · Last hour
panels.description: Most recent original HTTP event timestamp available in Loki within the last hour. No matching logs can mean no traffic or an ingestion issue. Independent of dashboard filters. This is event freshness, not measured ingestion delay.

targets.expr: 1000 * max(max_over_time({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event" | event="http_request" | __error__="" | label_format event_epoch="{{ __timestamp__ | unixEpoch }}" | unwrap event_epoch | __error__="" [1h]) by (job))

options.content: A successful log collector run means the Render API request completed successfully. A quiet application can have an old latest HTTP event; this alone is not a collection failure. Filters can also produce empty results. Error counters show zero only when matching HTTP traffic was observed; empty results do not prove an error-free system. P50/P95 curves use rolling 15-minute processing-time windows.

panels.title: Log collector · Age since successful run
panels.description: Seconds since the last successful log collector run. This is not the age of the last business request.

panels.title: Textfile collector · Scrape errors
panels.description: 0 = Node Exporter textfile metrics parsed successfully; 1 = parsing error.

panels.description: Traffic, Route contains, Log status and Request ID filters apply. Data links preserve the selected time range.
